premises.text: Teams are forced to use too many tools to get work done, leading to data silos and frustration.
premises.evidence_span: These days, teams are forced to use way too many tools to get their work done, tools that promise to streamline our workflows, improve our team collaboration, and bring our teams together.

premises.text: Existing all-in-one workspaces have a higher barrier of entry and cannot satisfy all team workflows.
premises.evidence_span: All-in-one workspaces like Zendesk and Notion, they come with a higher barrier of entry.

premises.text: Data integrators have limited interactivity and can create noise in data management.
premises.evidence_span: the main issue here is the level of interactivity between your data is limited. One-way synchronization does little to move your agenda forward, and adding layers of integrations just makes your data more noisy.

premises.text: Jamilius integrates with email to simplify teamwork and allows users to choose their preferred workspace.
premises.evidence_span: Jamilius starts by integrating with the most natural workspace of teams, and that's your email inbox.

premises.text: Jamilius turns email conversations into flexible channels for communication across platforms.
premises.evidence_span: We take your email conversations and turn them into flexible channels, channels that can then be translated into other forms of communication.

premises.text: Jamilius provides a visual representation of email conversations and project tasks.
premises.evidence_span: Jamilius boards give you a visual representation of your email conversations and all of the projects and tasks that follow.

premises.text: The market for team collaboration and workflow automation is projected to grow significantly.
premises.evidence_span: team collaboration will reach 17 billion. Workflow automation will reach 30 billion by the year 2025.

value.text: Jamilius empowers teams to communicate and collaborate effectively across different platforms.
value.evidence_span: the main point that we want to express is that our team in Geneva is ultra passionate about empowering teams and improving collaboration.
